## Publicaciones

### Economic perceptions and government approval in Chile: An analysis of democratic transition (1990–2022)

**Vicente Abrigo Zúñiga, Roberto Cases and Rodrigo Vergara**  
*Acta Politica, 2024*

Using individual-level survey data covering more than three decades of Chilean democracy, the paper examines how economic perceptions relate to government approval. The results show that perceptions of the national economy matter more than personal economic circumstances, while the strength of this relationship changes as Chile's democratic institutions consolidate.

[Paper](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1057/s41269-024-00374-2){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

## Trabajos en revisión

### The Role of Geography and Gender in Telecommunications Standards Participation

**Vicente Abrigo Zúñiga, Justus Baron and Tatiana Rosá**

*Working paper available through CAF. Currently under review.*

Using the rotation of meeting locations in 3GPP, the paper studies how travel frictions affect participation in telecommunications standard-setting. Distance and national borders significantly reduce attendance, with substantially larger effects for women, suggesting that geography continues to shape who participates in influential international standard-setting processes.

[Working paper](https://scioteca.caf.com/handle/123456789/2568){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}
